decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor builds on existing sensor module and firmware knowledge, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it.
The voltage measurement module is an iterative replacement of an existing analog input module, directly reusing related hardware and firmware knowledge.
The MQTT software proxy leverages the firm's existing software binding and connectivity expertise, keeping it within the firm's absorptive capacity.
The CAN bus interface module is close to existing communication modules, so the firm has related knowledge to assimilate and improve it.
The CO2 sensor module is similar to other environmental sensors, building on the firm's sensor integration knowledge.
Although the touch panel accessory is somewhat farther from core sensing/control modules, the firm's in-house electronics and firmware R&D can still assimilate and improve it.
